mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months (measured as the change in FEDFUNDS from t-3mo to t-1mo) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:FEDFUNDS declined from 4.5% to 4.49% in the past 3 months (2013-03-31 to 2013-05-31)
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%) and the federal funds rate shows minimal decline (FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% over 3 months), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% AND FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% over 3 months
regime_hint: monetary policy stagnation with high unemployment
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS change > 0.1% over 3 months), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% AND FEDFUNDS change > 0.1% over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances in the tightening cycle, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1200.0 (HOUST < 1200.0), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production declines by more than 0.5% (INDPRO change < -0.5% over 3 months) and housing starts remain below 1200.0 (HOUST < 1200.0), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO change < -0.5% over 3 months AND HOUST < 1200.0
evidence_refs: fact:Industrial production decline threshold: -0.5% over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales fall below 380000.0 (RSAFS < 380000.0), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < 380000.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime (INDPRO decline > 1.0% over 3 months), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Supply shock threshold: INDPRO decline > 1.0% over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances in the supply shock regime, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
